## Reading this

- The bound only counts the hub's own CZ pulses at ≥ 1.0 each. Everything else (non-hub edges,
  storage trips for 1q gates, block lifts) is free in the bound, so the true optimum is higher.
  But it shows the order of magnitude: on 50q p3 the best is 10–18× the bound.
- **Where the points are:** the four 50q p3 iHVA/QAOA circuits lose 5.9 points together, and all
  50q circuits about 9. The 12/20q circuits lose 0.2–0.6 each. HEA is already within a few tenths.
- The `*_warm` QAOA circuits have no zero-angle blocks (identical cost to plain QAOA). Only iHVA
  `tree_warm` has them (98 of 147 per layer at 50q).
- Depth is near its floor already (e.g. 396 vs 294 on 50q QAOA p3); distance is the lever.
